title: Time Jump: 19:30, 19 Moved, 9 Still on Scene

fields.narration: It is now 19:30. It is dark, with steady rain at 43 degrees and a low cloud ceiling over Highway 21 and County Road K. Firefighter Kowalczyk is in the LRMC Emergency Department, and the Rescue Group's personnel accountability report is complete. Six of the seven trapped patients are out of the bus. One is still being cut free forward of the rear axle. The diesel is diked at the storm drain, with about 38 gallons released so far. Here is the transport log since the START pass: three Immediate patients went to LRMC by ground. One Immediate head injury, tag LC-0414, left for Lakeshore on Air 7 at 19:12. Six Delayed patients went to LRMC. Two Delayed patients went to St. Brendan's, one of them tag LC-0417, which was redirected from Pinecrest at 18:52. Seven Minor patients went to the Brandt Lake High School minor injury site on the first Larkfield County Transit bus. Still in the treatment area: three Immediate, one Delayed, four Minor, and one Expectant patient who is being comforted and reassessed. LRMC opened its surge ward at 19:10. Pinecrest Memorial is still on Diversion, with nine walk-ins. The StatusGrid engineer says the remote fix is due at 19:50. CAD shows 11 pending calls county-wide. Channel 9 News has repeated '40 injured' at the top of every hour.
